content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with sauce (NFS) is a ready‑to‑eat meal consisting of cooked pasta coated with a tomato‑based sauce seasoned with herbs and sometimes cheese. The product is designed for quick preparation of a hot lunch or dinner, requiring only heating in a microwave or on the stove.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The NFS (New Food Solutions) brand focuses on convenient semi‑finished foods for home and office use.
The pasta is usually made from durum wheat, giving it a firm texture after cooking.
The sauce is typically enriched with tomato paste, basil, oregano, and a touch of olive oil.
Some packages include a small amount of dried parmesan flakes for sprinkling before serving.
Vacuum packaging and preservative agents give the product a long shelf life.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Pasta provides sustained energy through slowly digestible carbs, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Rich tomato sauce
items.content: Tomatoes contain lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that helps protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Contains plant protein
items.content: Durum wheat offers plant‑based protein that can contribute to daily protein needs.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Most of the fat comes from plant sources, making it more heart‑friendly.

items.title: B‑vitamin content
items.content: Pasta provides thiamine, niacin, and folate, essential for metabolic processes.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Wheat pasta contains gluten, which can trigger reactions in people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The sauce may be salty; individuals monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives used to extend shelf life may not be suitable for some sensitive individuals.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: While convenient, the meal can be calorie‑dense; portion control is advised for weight‑management diets.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in the microwave (about 3‑4 minutes) or on the stove, stir, and optionally add grated cheese, fresh herbs, or vegetables. Serve hot.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 2‑3 days and keep refrigerated.
